answer: Sponsorship carries liability: each vouch locks 97 POA behind the newcomer, and the voucher above loses half again if the chain is convicted. Sponsors are capped at 3 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army. The dune of the cap is the choke point, the lantern of the bond is the deterrent, and the yarrow of the public chain is the evidence. A farm of 680 aliases must recruit 680 separate sponsors willing to stake real funds on strangers.
